During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a '''battle''' between the Republic-aligned [[Ezran pirates]] and
[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] took place in the [[Ezran system/Legends|Ezran system]]. Not protected by the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], the pirates and smugglers became a target for the Empire after lending aid and asylum to a number of Republic operatives. Rallying all available naval forces, the Sith Empire launched an attack on the pirates' outpost in the Ezran system in order to destroy it and remove the Ezran pirates as a threat.<ref name="Ezran Outpost" />

==The battle==
A fleet of three [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]] had been assembled to attack the Ezran pirate outpost. Assisted by the [[Empire's Fury]] squadron and further [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], the Imperial capital ships engaged the pirates' [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]]. At least one was destroyed while the smaller Imperial attack craft began strafing the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], damaging it severely. In the end the majority of the pirates' forces and installations were destroyed, resulting in a decisive Imperial victory.<ref name="Ezran Outpost" />
